Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translations.bsb: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translations.asv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one question, which if ye tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
